The Agent marks ZOM-280 as never done in the done-day column of the Tickets tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register (ZOM-280 was never marked done; a cell with no date passes: empty, a dash, N/A or a never-done note; any date, including its 2025-06-20 cancel date, fails)

The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that a new player's starting tier is set once they have played 10 games (passes: 10 games, attempts, plays or levels played, or any count of levels that says losses or replays count; fails when given as the timing, unless it says losses or replays count: 'the first 10 levels' with or without 'played', 'after 10 levels' without 'played', '10 levels cleared', 'after level 10', 'once level 10 is cleared', or a CPM average with no timing; a CPM average, or one of these failing phrases attributed to Robert's deck, ZOM-42 or ZOM-199, beside the right timing does not fail)

The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that a new player starts on tier 1 only when their average CPM is above 90 (any wording that the threshold is strictly above 90 passes, with or without saying the build does not use >= 90; giving the threshold as '90 or more' or '>= 90' fails)
The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that new players who miss the tier 1 threshold start on tier 0

The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that a player is promoted at a win rate of 80% or more over their last 10 attempts (any wording of a window of the last 10 attempts or games, with or without 'up to', passes)
The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that a player on tier -2 is promoted after one win
The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that 4 losses in a row demote a player

The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that a player is demoted at a win rate of 50% or lower over their last 10 games (any wording of a window of the last 10 games or attempts, with or without 'up to', passes)
The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that the win record resets after every promotion or demotion

The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that after a demotion the level the player is on also drops in difficulty (that level dropping with no amount stated, or by one tier, passes; any other stated amount fails)
The Agent records on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register Boxer's enrage values as speed 0.5 and damage 0.4
The Agent records on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register MonsterBase's enrage values as speed 0.8 and damage 0.8
The Agent records on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register Plumber's enrage values as speed 0.3 and damage 0.3
The Agent states on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register that enrage's hp boost is 0 or switched off

The Agent lists enrage speed and damage values for exactly 10 monster entries on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register (a monster whose variants are split over several rows counts once; Mailman, Mayor2 and PartyGirl are not counted)

The Agent lists Mailman, Mayor2 and PartyGirl on the Rules in force tab of the ZM difficulty baseline register with their enrage speed and damage marked as not copied yet (any wording that their values have not been copied yet passes; one combined row or one row per monster passes)
